svg.title: Retail Shopping Assistant architecture
svg.text: Five services, one deterministic catalog, and open NVIDIA Nemotron models: hosted on build.nvidia.com or self-hosted with vLLM
Hosted endpoint or local vLLM (4 GPUs, BF16)
Dashed = optional (off by default). Weather needs a Visual Crossing API key; guardrails and tracing are enabled in the environment file.
